title: Ab Shaam Ho Rahi Hai
body:
Kehti thi ye Sakina, ab sham ho rahi hai
Bolo kahan ho baba, ab sham ho rahi hai
Jungle me mai akeli, dhoondu kaha batao
Aawaz deke tumhi, beti ko ab bullo
Dil muztarib hai mera, ab sham ho rahi hai
Kuch to batao mujhko, yeh kaisa imtehan hai
Neend aye kaise mujhko, kaisa seena tera kaha hai
Bechain hai Sakina, ab sham ho rahi hai
Ab jald aao mujhko, aaghosh me uthalo
Tum apni ladli ko, seeene pe ab sulalo
Neend aarahi hai baba, ab sham ho rahi hai
Gauhar bhi chin chuke hai, khati hoon mai tamache
Zaqmi hai kaan mere, ruqsaar bhi hai soojhe
Ye haal dekho mera, ab sham ho rahi hai
Kaise sitam huwe hai, dekho hamara alam
Khaime bhi jal chuke hai, baithe hai qaak par hum
Dijye hame sahara, ab sham ho rahi hai
Apna chahcha ko sari rudad hai sunani
Baba tumhari beti mangegi ab na pani
Ammu kaha hai mera , ab sham ho rahi hai
Sarwar ki lash kaanpi ran mein rasheed us dum
Bekas yateem bachi karti thi bain jis dum
Bibi ka tha ye nouha , ab sham ho rahi hai
